posts.title: Navigating copyright risks of AI-assisted code in 2026
posts.description: I did a little bit of research into the OpenJDK policies for generative AI after the ban I received yesterday from /r/java. I had assumed that code inside Oracle and specifically inside OpenJDK must be incorporating generative AI in 2026, since Oracle has been such a big proponent of AI.

posts.title: Getting Banned from r/java
posts.description: I got banned from r/java today for posting a Swing WebView component that I made. A lifetime ban.

posts.title: Reprogramming the Commercial Break
posts.description: So my son said to me this morning, just before heading to his swimming lesson, that he didn’t notice any commercials for Hoppers, this movie that he wants to see, and it’s already out of theatres.
